overall: The AG found violations for the January 24, 2014 notice listing the wrong time and for the February 12, 2014 notice omitting anticipated topics; no violation on the executive-session notice; two other allegations declined.

allegations.summary: Complaint that the January 24, 2014 meeting notice listed the wrong meeting time (10:30 P.M. instead of 10:30 A.M.), so the meeting was not properly noticed.
The February 12, 2014 notice, posted to remedy the January error, did not list all anticipated discussion topics, including the reason for the rehearing.
allegations.key_passage: Because the Chair clearly anticipated discussing those matters, we find that the Commission violated the Open Meeting Law by failing to specifically list all of the anticipated discussion topics in its February 12 meeting notice.

allegations.summary: Complaint that the individual subject to the April 4, 2014 executive session was not properly given written notice under G.L. c. 30A, § 21(a)(1) because counsel did not agree to accept service.
allegations.key_passage: We find that the Commission made reasonable efforts to comply with the notice requirement pursuant to G.L. c. 30A, § 21(a)(1) by sending the letter via email and certified mail to Ms. Tessmer along with a copy to her counsel.

allegations.summary: Complaint that the Commission held the April 4 meeting over the objection of the subject's counsel.
allegations.key_passage: Even if taken as true, these allegations would not constitute a violation of the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Complaint that the Commission's dismissal of an employee at the April 4 meeting resulted from improperly obtained information.
allegations.key_passage: Even if taken as true, these allegations would not constitute a violation of the Open Meeting Law.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law.

Going forward, comply with regional-body notice posting by posting in each town in the manner prescribed for local bodies there, or alternatively posting to the Airport's website (advisory, not a complaint finding).
remedy_passage: We therefore order the Commission's immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law, and caution that future similar conduct may be considered evidence of intent to violate the Open Meeting Law.
